_readme: The reference data for this deployment. This is the file you edit.
A subsystem is one repository the agents work in, plus the branch that
repository actually deploys from, plus the zone map that governs it.
Declare the branch explicitly. Do not assume 'main'. A reconciler that
merges agent work into a branch nothing deploys from reports every merge
as a success and changes nothing in production — a failure that looks
Override the location of this file with TURNSTILE_SUBSYSTEMS.
See INSTRUCTIONS.md for everything else that needs filling in.
_commit_identity: Commits the reconciler makes are attributed here. Keep it obviously
non-human: a merge that appears to come from a person is a merge
somebody will later be asked about and will not remember making.
